q_en:
Comprehension:
Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

Gender equality in education and employment is essential for building inclusive and progressive societies. When girls and boys have equal access to quality education, they acquire the knowledge and skills necessary to contribute meaningfully to economic and social development. Education empowers individuals to make informed choices, improve their lives, and uplift their communities.

Despite global efforts, gender disparities persist in many regions. Cultural norms, early marriage, domestic responsibilities, and lack of sanitary facilities often hinder girls’ education. Similarly, in employment, women face obstacles such as wage gaps, limited leadership roles, and workplace discrimination. These disparities not only violate basic rights but also restrict economic growth and innovation.

Policies that promote equal opportunities, provide flexible working conditions, and support women in leadership are crucial. Education systems must also be made more inclusive by addressing gender-specific needs and removing hidden biases in curricula.

Achieving gender equality is not only a matter of fairness—it is a smart investment in a nation’s future. A society that empowers all its members, regardless of gender, builds resilience, equity, and prosperity for generations to come.

The universe, a vast and awe-inspiring expanse, constantly reminds us of our insignificance. Every star, planet and galaxy seems to exist in a state of perpetual (1)_______, as if untouched by the fleeting nature of human (2)_______. Scientists often speculate about the existence of parallel worlds, yet they remain (3)_______ in their search for definitive evidence. Our understanding of the cosmos is limited by both our technological capabilities and our inherent (4)_______. Theories abound, but we are constantly faced with the (5)_______ of whether we will ever truly grasp the full nature of the universe.

Q. Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
Correct Answer: Option 3
Context:
• Mystery: Something that is difficult or impossible to understand.
• The final sentence discusses whether we will ever grasp the nature of the universe, framing it as an unsolved puzzle.

🇮🇳 हिंदी में:
सही उत्तर: mystery (रहस्य)
• क्या हम कभी ब्रह्मांड को पूर्णतः समझ पाएंगे, यह एक 'रहस्य' (mystery) बना हुआ है।
